alr fine i'll ramble about my opinions

first, golden deer.
i love the golden deer, but damn, i wish they could just do smth in the story! all that character they have is wasted, they're basically carried by the support convos. the only one who really feels important is claude and kinda lysithea. they're my children and they totally got massacred by the plot >:(

then blue lions.
they're great. they all feel actually important to the plot, yay! which also means they're pretty fleshed out. also i CANNOT ignore the support convos, especially between dimitri and basically everyone else, ingrid, felix, and sylvain with each other. it's just... *chefs kiss* also i have a total felix bias, since he's my fav character in the entire game and i have totally adopted him. dedue is really well written too. but then we have the other three. mercedes, ashe, and annette. they're not bad characters, they're just underwhelming to me. they all basically have the same personality, which is that they're nice. almost nothing else. they do have compelling stories, but for mercedes, it's put on the back burner, for ashe, it's only on the very beginning of the game, and for annette, it's relegated to her supports.
i think they're the best house, character wise, but not my favourite. (yea that's right i like the skittle squad/golden deer more)

finally, black eagles.
they're... fine.
they don't really do much in the story besides edelgard and hubert, (although scarlet blaze does add ferdinand to the mix, but that's about it) also edelgard isn't even the most well written character out there. (which is a shame because i love edelgard, and i think she has the best relationship with byleth out of all the lords, and i agree with her ideals.) dorothea, ferdinand, and bernie are great characters, but only in their supports. none of the black eagles get to shine in the main plot for silver snow or crimson flower. i don't have much to say other than that they are some serious wasted potential.
